driftDetection.primaryOwner: automation:6a742f6443e8819184310cd28e6162cd (existing central; evidence reconciliation and repair owner)
driftDetection.when: At each existing scheduled invocation and before any new affected external action; preserve the existing schedule. Record actual failed/missing reads as UNKNOWN, not a clear result.
detect: Correlate any original provider/task/dispatch result with the exact retained old ticket and dispatch; no inference from age.
Fresh-read the complete five target bodies and metadata, record old/planned literal counts, and compare central current source/head against actual newest original/child/pair own events and GitHub.

A newly appearing old SORI48-PAIR-ADMIT-20261029 announcement on index3 or a central current record promoting old cf4485d9 against a genuine newer frozen source is drift. Valid newer source projections may change the observational hashes; verify their attributed receipts rather than treating every change as bad.
A failed/incomplete source or target read does not prove absence of drift.
driftDetection.onDrift: Stop the affected scope's admission/Codex/merge/projection actions; save full read evidence, timestamps and exact old ticket/dispatch and current source; report owner=existing central and the actual remaining trigger. Only a separately reviewed source-preserving reconciliation may repair it. Never auto-replay/rollback an old snapshot, overwrite worker proof or manufacture ACK/no-send.
driftDetection.baselineMeaning: The target hashes are UTF-8 content/properties text exactly returned by Notion fetch, not native block identity or a no-send proof. Freeze fresh references/readbacks after each separately authorised new projection.
